translation: <ins>Fir fence (杉籬)</ins> (Instrument 9) The fir fence is an instrument for pressing again. Measure the length, width, narrowness, and the curved, straight, convex, and concave shapes of the affected place, and make it of fir wood. Weigh the number of pieces, and record the order clearly, so that it is not confused; then drill one hole at each end of every piece, and link them together with rope.
